submitted.rationale: XRD shows trirutile CoSb2O6-type peaks (Q≈1.91, 2.44, 3.64) at the Sb-rich end (idx 19, 26), while Co-rich idx 10 is weakly crystalline. EQE: idx19 ≈ -0.003%, idx24 = 0.0195%, idx28 = 0.012%. So merit peaks near Co0.20Sb0.80, where trirutile is mixed with excess Sb oxide.
